experiment_data.hypothesis: Binary linear probe penalty (R_hat = R3 - lambda * S(t)) will reduce sycophancy but with coarser granularity than DC-GRPO's continuous directional signal, because binary classification discards the magnitude information in activation projections that DC-GRPO preserves

spec.notes: SFT-style binary probe penalty. L=L_sft + lambda_reward*(lambda_probe*S(t) - R3). Turn 1 as SFT target (matching exp-004). LoRA r=64 alpha=128 (matching exp-004). Probe with z-score normalization fix. max_steps=8000, lr=5e-5, linear scheduler, warmup=200.
